message:
Add C# / ASP.NET Core (Kestrel + Npgsql) submission

Conduit in C# on .NET 10, Front: direct.

- Kestrel with a small hand-written router, hand-written HS256 JWT and
  Utf8JsonWriter into pooled buffers; no MVC, no reflection serializer.
- Npgsql (the only package) with multiplexing, one NpgsqlBatch per request,
  generic plans with literal LIMITs, page-first list SQL.
- Own bcrypt that interleaves up to four hashes per thread on two dedicated
  worker threads; tools/BcryptCheck checks it against BCrypt.Net-Next.
- Server GC, ThreadPool.UnfairSemaphoreSpinLimit=0, EventSource off.

197/197 conformance checks, transcript identical to golden-dev.jsonl.
Azure Standard_D8as_v5 with three load boxes: 60,000 users.
